<description>
**Problem:** Block and undo writers rely on the `BufferedWriter` destructor to write the last buffered bytes.
If the filesystem fills up, `fwrite()` can write fewer bytes than requested (my 1 TB benchmarking servers have been filling up, so I've been seeing these failures more often).
When this happens during the final flush, `AutoFile::write_buffer()` throws and the exception escapes the implicitly non-throwing destructor, invoking `std::terminate` before the node can report the write error and shut down normally.
Adding an explicit `flush()` alone would still leave the same bytes pending on failure, so the destructor would retry the write during unwinding.

I introduced this bug in #31551 when adding `BufferedWriter`.

**Fix:** Block and undo writers now flush explicitly. If serialization or flushing throws `std::ios_base::failure`, they call `discard()` to drop any pending bytes, log the error, close the file, and request shutdown.

`BufferedWriter::flush()` clears the pending byte count before calling `write_buffer()` and propagates any exception. Retrying would be unsafe because the stream may have obfuscated the bytes in place and a short write may already have put some of them on disk.
The destructor uses `Assume` to check that no bytes are pending before its fallback flush.

Manual write-error reproducer

Force `AutoFile::write_buffer()` to report a write failure even when `fwrite()` succeeds.

```sh
sed -i '' '/^.*AutoFile::write_buffer(/,/^}/s/!= src.size()/!= 0/' src/streams.cpp
cmake -B build && cmake --build build -j5 && build/bin/bitcoind -regtest -datadir="$(mktemp -d)"; echo "exit=$?"
```

Before this change, flushing from the destructor invokes `std::terminate`.

```text
libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::__1::ios_base::failure: AutoFile::write_buffer: write failed: unspecified iostream_category error
zsh: abort      build/bin/bitcoind -regtest -datadir="$(mktemp -d)"
exit=134
```

With this change, `bitcoind` logs the write failure, completes normal shutdown, and exits with status 1.

```text
Checking all blk files are present...
[error] Failed to write block file FlatFilePos(nFile=0, nPos=8): AutoFile::write_buffer: write failed: unspecified iostream_category error
...
Error: A fatal internal error occurred, see debug.log for details: Failed to write block.
[error] Writing genesis block to disk failed
[error] Error initializing block database
...
Shutdown done
exit=1
```
</description>
